base_training.data: winning proxy mixture scaled with >=95% unique prediction tokens overall and per-source replay caps
base_training.optimizer: AdamW beta1=0.9 beta2=0.95 weight_decay=0.1; FP32 master/state semantics required for production qualification
base_training.routing: dropless Top-2 with FP32 router logits; compare auxiliary-loss coefficient 0.001 and 0.01 plus auxiliary-loss-free bias only in bounded matched ablations
base_training.schedule: cosine with predeclared 5T horizon; peak LR selected by proxy, no mid-run horizon extension

claim_boundary: This freezes budgets, experiments, and fail-closed gates. It does not claim that 5.1T tokens are downloaded or admitted, that the >=50% MFU production path is qualified, or that the model exceeds any competitor.
data_admission_gates: immutable source revisions and byte hashes
document provenance and component license receipts
global URL exact document near and line-level deduplication
fresh evaluation contamination index with exact 13-gram fuzzy and semantic review
train validation and sealed test isolation
language domain and quality audits including random human review
tokenizer identity packed-shard hashes exact next-token counts and deterministic order
no benchmark train set in the final anneal

data_mix_selection.method: matched 529M proxy microanneals from one immutable parent, followed by two-seed confirmation before freezing the 7B mixture
data_mix_selection.retired_recipe: F2 continuation data recipe; its two-seed seven-task mean regressed from 0.4853114768 to 0.4845525333
data_mix_selection.reusable_engineering_from_f2: large microbatch low accumulation constant tokens per update deterministic resume and rolling MFU gates
selection_gates: all source identities and licenses admitted
same parent checkpoint optimizer schedule token count and record order across arms
finite training and validation metrics in every seed
rolling ten-step MFU median strictly above 0.70 for the 529M proxy after grace
two-seed gain on frozen multi-domain masked validation
no material regression on independent generated math executable code knowledge reading and multilingual probes
adaptive seven-task results may diagnose but cannot alone promote a mixture

high_quality_anneal.checkpoint_averaging: evaluate a preregistered 3-seed arithmetic average only after each component checkpoint passes independently
high_quality_anneal.learning_rate: linear decay from the inherited checkpoint LR to zero

quality_gates.competitor_claim_rule: same weights tokenizer prompts support setting sample rows metrics and scoring code; superiority requires a positive paired bootstrap lower bound against every named competitor
stop_or_revise_if: validation loss or downstream scaling slope stalls at two successive checkpoints
any domain materially regresses outside its preregistered margin
router imbalance expert starvation non-finite values or data identity drift
production median causal-useful MFU falls below 0.50 after warmup

performance_ladder: grouped expert GEMM and fused permutation/router kernels
distributed optimizer for shared and expert parameters
data parallel replicas only after expert-parallel correctness is frozen
requirements_before_production: all-tensor one-update parity against the numerical reference
FP32 master and optimizer-state semantics or independently qualified precision-aware optimizer
checkpoint save reload and topology conversion parity
sustained >=500-step confirmation with finite loss gradients and router load
no silent token drops and no expert starvation
same data order optimizer schedule and model fingerprint
